allocation_complete.reason: No allocated BMS requirement covers a permitted charging power/current; the cell-voltage requirement is a contactor-open protection and the thermal requests support charging only indirectly (loosely related).
allocation_complete.suggestion: Allocate a BMS charge power/current limit interface requirement (request it from the BMS if missing).

interface_only.reason: BMS_REQ_CELL_VOLTAGE_LIMITS, BMS_REQ_HEATING_REQUEST and BMS_REQ_COOLING_REQUEST are all tagged interface and exist only in BEV products.

no_value_copy.reason: Refers to 'the voltage window of its chemistry' without restating the chemistry-dependent cell voltage limits.

parent_fit.reason: Addresses the safety bounds of charging (cell voltage window, heating/cooling) but not the actual obligation of REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER, i.e. that the BMS permits the sustained charging power between 20 % and 80 % SoC.
parent_fit.suggestion: State the BMS's permitted charge power/current as the black box's contribution to the sustained charging power.

variant_consistency.reason: bms folder (bev), same as the bev-gated REQ_MAX_CHARGE_POWER.
